mutations.name: guard awaited (boot blocked by the check)
a bad role is always fatal, even when not required
a never-verified role is only a warning even when required
mutations.old:
const message = `could not verify the database runtime role after ${attempts} attempts (${lastError})`;
  if (options.require) options.fatal(message); else options.warn(message);
mutations.new:
const message = `could not verify the database runtime role after ${attempts} attempts (${lastError})`;
  options.warn(message);
